OUTPUT.DESCRIPTION: Follows the input after the delay
1 while a switching time is active
1 while a calendar entry is active

SEQUENCE_CONTROLLER.NAME: Sequence controller
SEQUENCE_CONTROLLER.DESCRIPTION: Runs sequences of steps written as text, one line per interval: set, setpulse, sleep, waitcondition, if/else/endif, goto, startsequence, return. A line "sequence <name>" starts a new sequence (up to 8).

START.DESCRIPTION: Starts the sequence with this number from line 1 (any value other than 0)

INPUT.DESCRIPTION: Analog input, used in the program as AI1..AI8

SELECT.DESCRIPTION: Starts the sequence with this number, 0 stops

OFF.DESCRIPTION: Off: stops, sets the outputs to 0 and locks the block while 1

OUTPUT.DESCRIPTION: Analog output, set in the program as AQ1..AQ8

ACTIVE.DESCRIPTION: Number of the running sequence, 0 = none

LINE.DESCRIPTION: Current line of the running sequence

TEXT.DESCRIPTION: Text output, set in the program with set TQ = "..."

ERRORS.DESCRIPTION: Errors in the program (invalid lines are skipped), empty when the program is valid

PROGRAM.NAME: Program
PROGRAM.DESCRIPTION: The sequences, one command per line. Example: sequence Heat / set AQ1 = 1 / waitcondition AI1 >= 55 / set AQ1 = 0

INTERVAL.NAME: Interval (ms)
INTERVAL.DESCRIPTION: Time between two steps, 20 to 1000 ms

PULSE_GENERATOR.NAME: Pulse generator
PULSE_GENERATOR.DESCRIPTION: While enabled the output alternates between 1 for the on time and 0 for the off time

ON.NAME: On time [s]
ON.DESCRIPTION: Duration of the 1 phase, at least 0.1 s

OFF.NAME: Off time [s]
OFF.DESCRIPTION: Duration of the 0 phase, at least 0.1 s

CLICK_DETECTION.NAME: Click detection
CLICK_DETECTION.DESCRIPTION: Tells single, double and triple clicks and a long press of a push button apart. The button must send 1 on press and 0 on release

SINGLE.DESCRIPTION: Pulse after a single click (one click window late)

LONG.DESCRIPTION: 1 from the long press time until the button is released

CLICK_WINDOW.NAME: Click window [ms]
CLICK_WINDOW.DESCRIPTION: Maximum time between two clicks of a double or triple click

LONG_PRESS.NAME: Long press [ms]
LONG_PRESS.DESCRIPTION: Hold time for a long press, 0 = off (for buttons that send no release)

OFF.DESCRIPTION: 1 resets the output and locks the block until Off is 0 again

ON_OFF_DELAY.NAME: Switch-on and -off delay
ON_OFF_DELAY.DESCRIPTION: The output follows the input, switching on after the on delay and off after the off delay

ON.NAME: On delay [s]
ON.DESCRIPTION: Time the input must be 1 before the output switches on

OFF.NAME: Off delay [s]
OFF.DESCRIPTION: Time the input must be 0 before the output switches off

SAVING_ON_DELAY.NAME: Saving switch-on delay
SAVING_ON_DELAY.DESCRIPTION: A pulse at the input switches the output on after the delay; it stays on until Off

OUTPUT.DESCRIPTION: 1 from the end of the delay until Off

DELAY.NAME: Delay [s]
DELAY.DESCRIPTION: Time from the pulse until the output switches on

EDGE_WIPING_RELAY.NAME: Edge-triggered wiping relay
EDGE_WIPING_RELAY.DESCRIPTION: Every pulse at the input sends a fixed number of pulses at the output

ON.NAME: On time [s]
ON.DESCRIPTION: Length of each pulse, at least 0.1 s

OFF.NAME: Off time [s]
OFF.DESCRIPTION: Pause between two pulses, at least 0.1 s

CYCLES.NAME: Cycles
CYCLES.DESCRIPTION: Number of pulses per input pulse

DELAYED_PULSE.NAME: Delayed pulse
DELAYED_PULSE.DESCRIPTION: A pulse at the input sends a pulse at the output after the delay

TRIGGER.DESCRIPTION: Pulse starts the delay, another pulse during the delay restarts it

DELAY.NAME: Delay [s]
DELAY.DESCRIPTION: Time from the input pulse to the output pulse

PULSE.NAME: Pulse length [s]
PULSE.DESCRIPTION: Length of the output pulse, at least 0.1 s

PWM.NAME: Pulse width modulation
PWM.DESCRIPTION: Turns an analog value 0..10 into an on/off signal with that duty cycle

VALUE.DESCRIPTION: Duty cycle 0..10 (0 = always off, 10 = always on)

PERIOD.NAME: Period [s]
PERIOD.DESCRIPTION: Length of one on/off cycle, at least 0.1 s

RAMP.NAME: Ramp controller
RAMP.DESCRIPTION: Moves the output step by step every 100 ms towards one of two levels

STOP.DESCRIPTION: 1 sets the output to the start value and holds it

START.NAME: Start value
START.DESCRIPTION: Value at the start and while Stop is 1

STEP.NAME: Step size
STEP.DESCRIPTION: Change per 100 ms, 0 = jump to the level

ALARM_CLOCK.NAME: Alarm clock
ALARM_CLOCK.DESCRIPTION: Alarm times per weekday and per operating mode (public holiday, vacation, ...), with snooze and pre-alarm. Entries for an active operating mode replace the weekday entries. The alarm times can be edited in the visualization

SNOOZE.DESCRIPTION: Starts the snooze: buzzer off for the snooze duration, another pulse restarts it

TOGGLE.DESCRIPTION: Switches the default alarm on/off, ends a running alarm

SET.DESCRIPTION: Sets the time of the default alarm in minutes after midnight (360 = 06:00)

OFF.DESCRIPTION: Ends a running alarm and resets the outputs

BUZZER.DESCRIPTION: 1 while the alarm sounds, 0 during the snooze

ALARM.DESCRIPTION: 1 while the alarm is active (also during the snooze)

PRE_ALARM.DESCRIPTION: Pulse the pre-alarm time before the alarm

DEFAULT_ENABLED.DESCRIPTION: 1 while the default alarm is switched on

NEXT_ALARM.DESCRIPTION: Date and time of the next alarm

MAX_DURATION.NAME: Maximum alarm duration [s]
MAX_DURATION.DESCRIPTION: Ends the alarm after this time (with confirmation required the snooze starts instead), 0 = until confirmed

PRE_ALARM_TIME.NAME: Pre-alarm time [s]
PRE_ALARM_TIME.DESCRIPTION: Time before the alarm when the pre-alarm pulses, 0 = off

SNOOZE_DURATION.NAME: Snooze duration [s]
SNOOZE_DURATION.DESCRIPTION: Time until the alarm sounds again

CONFIRM_REQUIRED.NAME: Confirmation required
CONFIRM_REQUIRED.DESCRIPTION: After the maximum alarm duration the snooze starts automatically until the alarm is confirmed

SUPPRESS_MODES.NAME: No weekday alarms during
SUPPRESS_MODES.DESCRIPTION: Operating modes (comma separated keys) on which the weekday alarms do not ring, unless an entry for that mode exists

ALARMS.NAME: Alarm entries
ALARMS.DESCRIPTION: Alarm times as JSON: [{"name":"","time":"06:30","enabled":true,"days":[1,2,3,4,5],"modes":["vacation"]}], days 0 = Sunday. Easiest to edit in the visualization

PULSE_AT.NAME: Pulse at
PULSE_AT.DESCRIPTION: Pulse at a time of day, at sunrise/sunset/dawn/dusk or every minute, hour, day, week, month or year. The time can be changed in the visualization. Sun events use the server location

OUTPUT.DESCRIPTION: 1 for the on-duration at the selected time

NEXT.DESCRIPTION: Date and time of the next pulse

TIME.NAME: Time
TIME.DESCRIPTION: Time of day hh:mm:ss (pulse type time of day)

ONE_TIME.NAME: One-time pulse
ONE_TIME.DESCRIPTION: Pulses only on the date below (time of day and sun events)

DATE.NAME: Date
DATE.DESCRIPTION: Date of the one-time pulse, yyyy-MM-dd

RUNTIME_COUNTER.NAME: Runtime counter
RUNTIME_COUNTER.DESCRIPTION: Counts the operating time while enabled (e.g. operating hours of a pump) and signals when the maintenance interval is reached. The counters survive restarts

RESET_TOTAL.DESCRIPTION: Resets the total operating time and the maintenance interval

MAINTENANCE.DESCRIPTION: 1 when the maintenance interval is reached

LAST_START.DESCRIPTION: Date and time of the last start

UNIT.NAME: Time unit
UNIT.DESCRIPTION: Unit of the outputs total and remaining time

INTERVAL.NAME: Maintenance interval [h]
INTERVAL.DESCRIPTION: Operating hours between two maintenances, 0 = not used

RANDOM_CONTROLLER.NAME: Random controller
RANDOM_CONTROLLER.DESCRIPTION: Switches on and off at random intervals while enabled, e.g. for presence simulation

ENABLE.DESCRIPTION: Runs while 1, 0 stops and switches off

MAX_ON_DELAY.NAME: Maximum switch-on delay [s]
MAX_ON_DELAY.DESCRIPTION: Longest time before switching on (off phase)

MAX_OFF_DELAY.NAME: Maximum switch-off delay [s]
MAX_OFF_DELAY.DESCRIPTION: Longest time before switching off (on phase)

OPERATING_MODE.NAME: Operating mode
OPERATING_MODE.DESCRIPTION: 1 while a system operating mode (public holiday, vacation, school holidays or a custom mode) is active. The modes and their periods are set up under Operating modes in the administration

ON.DESCRIPTION: 1 switches the mode on, 0 hands it back to the operating times

MODES.DESCRIPTION: All active modes, comma separated (highest priority first)

MODE.NAME: Mode
MODE.DESCRIPTION: Key of the operating mode: public-holiday, vacation, school-holidays or the key of a custom mode
